rationale: Deliberate saturation ABOVE the published envelope: producer rate 5000 events/s/cpu exceeds the consumer drain rate 1000. The kernel drops stale events at the head of the ring buffer to preserve ordering, so the failure counter is non-zero (47 events shed) but no sequence gap is visible to the consumer. verdict = saturation-detected-no-critical-loss (the published envelope was shed deliberately; no critical synthetic fixture loss occurred because ordering was preserved by the head-drop policy). The 47 value is the recorded non-zero monotonic reserve-failure delta from a controlled run on the unprivileged build host; a privileged runner (task 53+) will overwrite this fixture with a live recording.
